item.title: President Marcos values the importance of the Philippine press
item.description: President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. on Tuesday underscored the importance of a free and independent press in a democracy, calling for mutual respect and open dialogue between the government and the media even when they disagree. item.title: PCO vows to strengthen PTV’s role in government communications
item.description: Newly appointed acting Presidential Communications Office (PCO) Secretary Lino Cayetano said the People’s Television Network (PTV) will continue to play a key role in promoting transparency and accountability by making President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.’s messages and government programs more accessible and understandable to the public. Cayetano, who previously served as PTV general manager, said he had been helping the administration improve the way government messages are communicated to Filipinos
